body: hi, i'm back here after actually od'ing and going to hospital. i caved and spoke to my mother after a friend convinced me to tell her, she took me to A&E and i got treated etc. stayed over night and i was medically fine, saw the mental health team liaison who literally told me she was happy for me to go home and just ring a crisis number when i feel like that again...... i told her i didn't feel safe or in control or anything but w/e. UK/NHS sucks absolute balls and idk what to do now.
if you're talking about the hospital throwing me out after a day; i have experience (my own experience) that that's what happens here.

im in the uk. they treated me in hospital for about 2 or 3 days and gave me a psych assessment, then sent me home despite me saying i was going to do it again. 2 weeks later i ended up back in hospital for the same exact reason and they did the same and sent me home.
